title: JWST Mid-Infrared: How We Read Exoplanet Air (2026)
description:
Most people think we see exoplanets as dots. We don't. We read their air.

This 60-second breakdown shows how JWST's mid-infrared spectra fingerprint molecules like CO2 and methane. You'll see the exact spectral dips that reveal a planet's atmosphere, and why water vapor is the tricky part.

Watch to the end for the final atmospheric composition map.

#JWST #Exoplanets #SpaceScience #Astronomy #MidInfrared
